company.name: Chorus Sleep
company.shortDescription: Chorus Sleep provides a program and application designed to assist workers in improving their sleep patterns.
company.description:
Chorus Sleep provides a program and application designed to assist workers in improving their sleep patterns.

It offers audio sessions and tools, sleep tracking and coaching, as well as interactive content.

Chorus Sleep's founders are Ali Abramovitz, MK Hurlbutt, and Warren Runk.

productsAndServices.description: A mobile application that tracks sleep, offers relaxation sessions, provides educational content, and supports at-home diagnostic tests to improve sleep quality.
productsAndServices.name: Chorus Sleep App

productsAndServices.description: A personalized coaching service providing human support to help users follow their specific sleep improvement programs.
productsAndServices.name: Chorus Sleep Coaching Program

productsAndServices.description: A tool for employers to anonymously measure and analyze employee sleep health, sentiment, and productivity data.
productsAndServices.name: Employer Sleep Insights Dashboard

productsAndServices.description: Home-based tests available through the app to diagnose sleep conditions such as sleep apnea and severe insomnia.
productsAndServices.name: At-Home Sleep Diagnostic Tests

productsAndServices.description: A service facilitating quick and affordable access to sleep apnea devices for users diagnosed with the condition.
productsAndServices.name: Sleep Apnea Device Procurement Service
